name: MH370
summary: A Boeing 777 carrying 239 people vanished from radar en route from Kuala Lumpur to Beijing. No confirmed wreckage site has ever been found.

name: Zodiac Killer
summary: A serial killer operating in Northern California taunted police and media with cryptic letters and ciphers. The killer's identity was never officially confirmed.

name: Dyatlov Pass
summary: Nine experienced hikers died under mysterious circumstances in the Ural Mountains. Their tent was cut open from the inside and they fled without shoes in sub-zero temperatures.

name: D.B. Cooper
summary: A man calling himself Dan Cooper hijacked a Northwest Orient flight, extorted $200,000, and parachuted into the wilderness, never to be identified. The only unsolved hijacking in US aviation history.

name: Wow Signal
location: Big Ear Radio Observatory, Ohio, USA
summary: A strong narrowband radio signal received by SETI researcher Jerry Ehman bore all the hallmarks of potential extraterrestrial origin. It has never been detected again.

name: Voynich Manuscript
summary: A 240-page illustrated manuscript written in an unknown script and language. Carbon-dated to the early 1400s, it has resisted decipherment by expert cryptographers for over a century.
